education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Business Management

bullets.text: Led onboarding projects for financial institutions by coordinating cross-functional teams and supporting SaaS adoption.
Created and maintained training resources, FAQs, process guides, and project documentation.
Managed daily reconciliation and issue-resolution workflows by tracking tasks, identifying roadblocks, and coordinating with internal stakeholders.
Supported client accounting teams through structured communication and project updates aligned with client goals.
Collaborated with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams in an Agile environment to support product initiatives from planning through launch.
Gathered merchant feedback, identified recurring pain points, and translated findings into recommendations for Product and Engineering.
Led customer onboarding and product training programs supporting adoption and long-term engagement.
Served as a primary technical contact for complex product issues, coordinating root-cause analysis and resolution across teams.
Directed recruitment and onboarding for a 25-person team, aligning training plans with business goals and customer-service standards.
Designed process improvements based on user feedback and needs analysis.
Documented workflows and coordinated operational improvement work to address service gaps.
Partnered with dealer executives to assess needs, plan training programs, and deliver staff enablement sessions.
Developed project reports and training materials supporting continuous improvement across dealer operations.
Oversaw onboarding initiatives by aligning lifecycle communications with project goals.
Acted as liaison between dealer partners and internal teams to communicate and execute project requirements.
